buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of HMS NALBARI MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Terms and Conditions: 1. The Service Provider shall provide trained, literate, disciplined, and reliable security personnel for 24×7 round-the-clock vigilan ce, covering all seven (07) days of the week, to safeguard the In stitute's properties and belongings against theft, pilferage, and other risks. 2. The Service Provider shall deploy trained and experienced sup ervisory security staff in all three shifts to supervise the securit y personnel and manage administrative functions of the securit

y office at NMCH, Nalbari. 3. All security personnel shall wear proper and distinctive unifor ms while on duty. The Service Provider shall, at its own cost, pr ovide uniforms, raincoats, shoes, socks, batons (lathis), torches , communication device and other necessary equipment. A mobile phone shall be provided at each security gate for com munication with NMCH’s Management authority. All associated costs shall be borne by the Service Provider. 4. Each security personnel shall be entitled to one paid weekly off after six (06) consecutive working days. Deployment for more th an one shift within a 24-hour period is strictly prohibited. In cas e of sickness or absenteeism, a replacement guard shall be prov ided immediately by the Service Provider. 5. Security personnel shall be physically active and of good moral character. The Service Provider shall verify and maintain record s of residential and permanent addresses, antecedents, identity proof, photographs, character, and conduct of all deployed pers onnel and submit the same to NMCH. Police verification is a pre requisite for deployment of security personnel, which should be arranged by the Service Provider from the begining. 6. Security personnel shall be adequately trained in all aspects of security duties, including operation of firefighting equipment. P roof of such training or an undertaking that training will be com pleted within 30 days of deployment shall be submitted to NMC H. 7. In the event of leave or absence of any security personnel, the Service Provider shall make suitable alternate arrangements so that the sanctioned strength is always maintained. 8. Security personnel shall not be changed frequently without the prior consent of NMCH’s Management, except for unavoidable r easons. 9. If additional security personnel are required on a temporary ba sis, the Service Provider shall arrange the same. Payment for su ch additional deployment shall be made on a pro-rata basis at a

pproved rates. 10. The Service Provider shall ensure that all deployed personnel maintain discipline and do not engage in any activity prejudicial to the interests of the Institute or the Government of Assam. 11. The Service Provider shall be solely responsible for compliance with all applicable labour laws, including payment of wages, allo wances, compensation, provident fund, ESI, bonus, etc. Any lia bility incurred by NMCH on this account shall be fully indemnifie d by the Service Provider. 12. Income Tax (TDS) and GST, as applicable, shall be deducted fro m the monthly bills of the Service Provider. 13. An agreement shall be executed initially for a period of two (02 ) years, extendable as per mutual consent and GeM Terms and C onditions. 14. In case of theft, pilferage, or loss caused due to negligence, de reliction of duty, or misconduct of security personnel, the Servic e Provider shall make good the loss and NMCH may impose pen alties subject to maximum of 10% of the annual contract value or cost of item lost, whichever is less. NMCH shall have the right to deduct such amounts from the bills. The decision of the comp etent authority of NMCH shall be final and binding. 15. The Service Provider shall comply with all instructions issued b y NMCH Management from time to time. The agreement may be terminated with 30 days' notice, or earlier in case of violations. 16. Monthly security bills shall normally be paid within five (45) da ys of submission/ payment is arranged as per availability of fun d in the Hospital User’s Fund”. Bills shall be submitted by the S ervice Provider on or before the 3rd day of the succeeding mont h. a. Payment shall be released only upon submission of the monthly bill, duly certified by the concerned Officer/In-charge, confirming satisfact ory deployment and performance of the manpower supplied during th e relevant month. b. No advance payment shall be made under any circumstances. c. Release of payment shall be subject to the availability of funds with t

he institution. d. The Service Provider shall be solely responsible for the timely payme nt of wages, statutory contributions, and all other benefits payable to the personnel deployed by it, in accordance with applicable labour la ws and statutory provisions. The manpower deployed shall remain th e employees of the Service Provider, and no employer-employee relat ionship shall exist between such personnel and the Hospital Authority . The Hospital Authority shall have no direct or indirect financial liabili ty towards the personnel engaged by the Service Provider. e. Since Security Services are essential hospital services, payment shall be made only for the actual shifts manned/operated by the personnel deployed by the Service Provider, subject to the availability of the Ho spital Users Fund and/or other Government funds. Payment shall be p rocessed on the basis of attendance sheets duly verified by the In-ch arge Deputy Superintendent of the Hospital or as assigned by the aut hority and other relevant supporting documents. f. No additional claim, under any account whatsoever, shall be entertai ned by Nalbari Medical College & Hospital (NMCH), Nalbari, beyond th e payment admissible under the terms and conditions of the Tender/ GeM Bid Document. g. The Service Provider shall ensure that all personnel engaged for Sec urity Services receive their entitled monthly wages in full and on time , irrespective of whether payment against the monthly bill has been r eceived from NMCH, Nalbari. h. The Service Provider shall pay the entitled wages to the deployed pe rsonnel during the last week of the month or by the 5th day of the suc ceeding month. Such payment shall not be linked or conditional upon the release of payment by NMCH, Nalbari. The Hospital Authority shal l not be responsible for any delay in payment of wages arising due to shortage/non-availability of the Hospital Users Fund or non-receipt of any other Government fund. i. The following procedure shall be strictly followed by the Service Prov ider: I. Payment of Wages: The Service Provider shall pay the entitle d wages to the deployed personnel within the prescribed period , i.e., during the last week of the month or the 5th day of the suc ceeding month, irrespective of the status of payment of the mo nthly bill by NMCH, Nalbari. II. Mode of Payment: Payment of wages shall be made only thro ugh the individual bank accounts of the deployed personnel. Un der no circumstances shall wages be paid in cash. The Service P rovider shall ensure that every engaged Security personnel has an operational bank account. Where any personnel does not alr eady possess a bank account, the Service Provider shall facilitat e the opening of an appropriate bank account.

III. Timely Credit of Wages: The Service Provider shall ensure tha t the entitled wages of all deployed personnel are credited to th eir respective bank accounts within the prescribed period. No re laxation in this requirement shall be permitted. IV. Certificate to Accompany Monthly Bill: At the time of submissi on of each monthly bill, the Service Provider shall submit a duly signed certificate confirming the following: a. That the wages of the deployed Security personnel have been credited to their respective bank accounts on the du e date. b. That the ESI contribution relating to the eligible personnel has been duly deposited on the prescribed date. Documen tary proof of payment shall be enclosed. c. That the EPF contribution relating to the eligible personne l has been duly deposited on the prescribed date. Docume ntary proof of payment shall be enclosed. d. That the EDLI contribution relating to the eligible personn el has been duly deposited on the prescribed date. Docum entary proof of payment shall be enclosed. e. That any other statutory contribution applicable to the eli gible personnel, as specified in the GeM Bid Document, ha s been duly deposited within the prescribed time. Docume ntary proof of payment shall be enclosed. f. That the Service Provider is complying with all applicable Central and State labour laws, statutory provisions, and mi nimum wage requirements, including the applicable Minim um Wages Act/Rules. g. Failure on the part of the Service Provider to comply with the above payment, wage, statutory contribution, or labou r law requirements may result in withholding of payment, recovery of applicable dues, imposition of penalties, and/o r such other action as may be permissible under the terms and conditions of the Tender/GeM Bid Document and appli cable laws. 17. Wages shall be disbursed to deployed personnel through bank transfer on or before the last week of the every month or by the 5th day of the succeeding month, and proof of payment shall be submitted to NMCH. 18. In case of non-compliance, NMCHs reserves the right to: a. Cancel or revoke the contract/order; and b. Impose penalties as per the Service Level Agreement (SLA).

19. The offer shall be subject to verification of documents and sati sfactory past performance. Submission of false documents shall result in rejection of the offer and forfeiture of security deposit. 20. Security personnel shall be able to read, write, and communica te in Hindi, English, and Assamese (local language). 21. All personnel deployed shall be employees of the Service Provi der only. NMCH shall bear no employer-employee responsibility whatsoever. 22. If the Service Provider fails to deploy the required personnel o n any day, proportionate deductions along with penalties and st atutory charges shall be made from the bill. 23. All security personnel shall behave politely and professionally with students, visitors, patients, and staff. 24. NMCH shall not be responsible for any injury, disability, or dea th of the Service Provider's personnel. The Service Provider shal l obtain adequate insurance coverage for all deployed staff. 25. Normal duty hours shall not exceed eight (08) hours per shift. 26. No guard shall leave the duty post until the reliever reports an d formally takes charge. 27. The number of security posts, shifts, and deployment pattern shall be determined solely by NMCH authorities. 28. The Service Provider shall ensure round-the-clock watch and w ard of the entire NMCH premises. 29. Shortfall due to leave, illness, or any other reason shall be im mediately compensated by deploying substitute personnel at no additional cost. 30. Duty shifts shall normally be: * 1st Shift: 06:00 hrs – 14:00 hrs * 2nd Shift: 14:00 hrs – 22:00 hrs * 3rd Shift: 22:00 hrs – 06:00 hrs 31. NMCH may request removal of any deployed personnel for vali d reasons, and the Service Provider shall comply immediately. 32. The Service Provider shall comply with all statutory requireme

nts including minimum wages as notified by the Government of Assam, PF, ESI, GST, etc. 33. Monthly proof of PF and ESI contributions shall be submitted a long with bills for payment release. 34. The contract may be terminated with one month's notice, or o ne week's notice in case of breach or unsatisfactory service. 35. The successful bidder shall execute an agreement on Rs. 100 s tamp paper, the cost of which shall be borne by the Service Pro vider. 36. No guard shall perform double duty or consecutive shifts. Any violation shall result in deduction of the entire payment for suc h duty. 37. Guards found absent, sleeping, intoxicated, smoking, or misbe having shall attract penalties and deductions. 38. Security personnel shall assist in operating lighting systems, d oors, and shutters within the campus as required. 39. Weekly off shall be ensured. NMCH shall not provide accommo dation or food facilities. Monthly duty rosters shall be submitte d by the 3rd working day of each month. 40. Security personnel shall ensure proper upkeep of furniture and fixtures entrusted to them. 41. Performance of the Service Provider shall be reviewed periodic ally. Unsatisfactory performance may lead to termination witho ut prior notice. 42. The Service Provider shall ensure smooth handover and transf er of records from the previous agency. 43. The decision of NMCH Management regarding the security cont ract shall be final and binding. All disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Nalbari only 6.
